examples.japanese: {舅|しゅうと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: My father-in-law passed away last year.

examples.japanese: {舅|しゅうと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I have a good relationship with my father-in-law.

examples.japanese: {舅|しゅうと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{姑|しゅうとめ}→姑：05110_shuutome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to greet my father-in-law and mother-in-law.

notes:
{舅|しゅうと} refers to the father of one's spouse. The kanji {舅|しゅうと} is rarely used in everyday writing; hiragana しゅうと is more common.

REGISTER:
In formal or polite speech, ⟦{義父|ぎふ}→義父：06725_gifu⟧ or お⟦{義父|とう}さん→義父：06725_gifu⟧ is preferred. ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧ (literally "father by obligation/marriage") is also used. {舅|しゅうと} itself has a slightly literary or traditional feel.

- ⟦{義父|ぎふ}→義父：06725_gifu⟧: father-in-law (formal/written)
- ⟦{義母|ぎぼ}→義母：06724_gibo⟧: mother-in-law (formal/written)
- ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧: parents-in-law
- ⟦{嫁|よめ}→嫁：03670_yome⟧: daughter-in-law, wife

CULTURAL NOTE:
Relationships with in-laws (⟦{嫁姑|よめしゅうとめ}→嫁姑：noentry⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧) are a frequent topic in Japanese culture, especially the often-tense relationship between a wife and her mother-in-law.
